newsitem.title: INDIA: Fresh industrial buying lifts Indian copper prices.
newsitem.headline: Fresh industrial buying lifts Indian copper prices.

text.p: Indian copper prices on Thursday lifted further on fresh industrial buying while nickel and tin suffered a fresh setback, dealers said.
Other base metals were steady in a a narrow price band.
Copper rose by 25 rupees to 3,900 rupees per quintal on resumption of industrial buying. Copper was up by 25 rupees on Wednesday.
"Copper was dull last week due to the absence of physical buying but now we are witnessing increased enquiries," said Sharad Parikh, a leading dealer.
Nickel and tin prices fell further on higher supplies of imported meals and losses in the world market. Tin fell by 200 rupees to 29,600 and nickel fell by 200 rupees to 34,300 rupees per quintal.
Zinc was quoted at the previous level of 8,150 rupees per quintal, lead at 4,100 rupees and aluminium at 7,700 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
